ValidationRule.description: Prevents updates to PHOCS Violation records when Status is Resolved, unless the user has the EHIS Bypass Validation Rule custom permission.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSRegulatoryCodeViolation", NOT($Permission.EHISBypassValidationRuleCustomPermission), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Resolved"), NOT(ISCHANGED(Status)), NOT(ISCHANGED(DateResolved)) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Resolved"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Resolved")) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Violation record cannot be edited once the status is marked as Resolved
